goal: Accept the final Game Boy nominal static packaging study with source-bound rest geometry, independent static mate review, separately evaluated button poses and access envelopes, and explicit purchased-part/retention/harness limitations. This is not an articulated workspace or manufacturing acceptance claim.

attempts.title: Attempt 01

findings: One handheld assembly is shown; the model contains 59 named bodies with 58 fixed mates.
The 90×148×30 mm shell keeps the intended vertical handheld proportion, with the display above the controls.
Exterior shows the screen surround, D-pad, A/B, Start/Select, speaker slots, seam and case screw access.
The section locates the PCB/module/header stack, button support and connector inside the shell. The external plug and labeled keepouts have deliberate roles.
Header collars seat between board faces; support feet share the lower PCB fasteners; case screws have captive nuts. Cover and LCD retention remain declared unfinished details.
Display and controls face +Z, the USB plug approaches from +Y, and the Black Pill components face the rear.
The section shows separate shells, carrier, guided plungers, header pins, LCD and relocated J1 with wire-exit space.
Exterior and center section agree on the shell stack and external plug location; neither view is a physical fit or load test.
